senses.gloss:
(I)--a son of राम, born in वाल्मिकी's आश्रम and brought up by the sage. Father of Atithi.
1: भा. IX. ११. ११; १२. 1; M. १२-51; Vi. 4. १०४-5.
Ruled over Kosala kingdom from its capital कुशस्थली.
2: Br. III. ६३. १९८; Vi. ८८. १९८-9.
(II)--a son of Ajaka; father of four sons, कुशाम्बु and others. भा. IX. १५. 4.
(III)--a son of Suhotra and father of Prati. भा. IX. १७. 3, १६.
(IV)--a son of Vidarbha. भा. २४. 1.
(V)--the son of बलाकाश्व. Father of कौशाम्ब and three other sons. Br. III. ६६. ३१-2; Vi. IV. 7. 8.
(VI)--a son of Caidyoparicara (Vidyoparicara- वा प्।). M. ५०. २७; वा. ९९. २०२.
(VII)--a son of Gaya and father of four sons, all versed in the Vedas. वा. ९१. ६१-2. [page१-412+ ३४]

(VIII)--(कुशद्वीप, कुमुदद्वीपम्?)--thrice the Suroda in size surrounded by घृतोड (sea of Ghee) (milk ocean-म्।प्।). Its name comes from a shining divine cluster of grass in it. Its king was a son of Priyavrata, हीरण्यरेतस्, who divided it among his seven sons. Here Agni is worshipped.
1: भा. V. 1. ३२; २०. १३-17; M. १२२. ४९; वा. ३३. १२; ४९. ४७-58.
ज्योतिष्मत्, its first king divided it among his seven sons. Their names, and the names of hills and rivers described.
2: Br. II. १४. १२-30; १९. ५२-64.
A तीर्थम् sacred to कुशोदका
3: M. १३. ५०.
in the neighbourhood of जम्बूद्वीप;
4: वा. ४८. १४. ३४.
of different villages and the residence of Kumuda the wily sister of महादेव.
5: Ib. ४८. ३४-35.
(II)--the lord of साङ्काश्य and brother of सीरध्वज Janaka. Vi. IV. 5. २९.
(I)--one of the four sons of कुश. भा. IX. १५. 4; Br. III. ६६. ३२; वा. ९१. ६२; Vi. IV. 7. 8.
(II)--a son of Vaivasvata Manu. M. ११. ४१.
--the peoples of a hilly country. वा. ४५. १३६. [page१-413+ २२]
--On this Diti performed her penance. Br. III. 5. ५५-6.
--a son of वेदशिरस्, an अवतार् of the १५थ् dva1para. वा. २३. १६९.
--a son of Dyutimat after whom कौशल des4a came to be called. Br. II. १४. २२-24; वा. ३३. २१; Vi. II. 4. 48
--the name of the forest where Diti performed penance to get a son to slay Indra. वा. ६७. ९४.
--a class of people in कुशद्वीप. भा. V. २०. १६.
--a son of बाष्कल. वा. ६७. ७९.
(I)--the Apsara clan. Br. III. 7. २२.
(II)--a R. of the केतुमाल continent. वा. ४४. १८.
(I)--a Mt. in कुशद्वीप, after which the island is named. Br. II. १९. १३९; M. १२३. ३७. [page१-414+ ३०]
(II)--(कुशनाभ): performed austeri- ties for १००० years for a son; Indra the १००० eyed offered himself to be born his son. वा. ९१. ६३-5.

--see द्वारका
1: भा. I. १०. २७; Br. III. ६१. २०, ff; वा. ८८. १९९.
--capital of आनर्त (कोशल- वा। प्।) kingdom. Comparable once to अमरावती, dis- appeared; and in its place came द्वारका; finding Kakudmi, its king not returning from ब्रह्मलोक, राक्षसस् like पुण्यजनस् entered it and his ९९ brothers fled to different directions in fear, and established small kingdoms there.
2: M. १२. २२; ६९. 9; वा. ८६, २४. ८८. 1-2.
--a son of अशोक: ruled for eight years. Br. III. ७४. १४६.
--the son of बृहद्रथ and father of ऋषभ. (वृषभ-म्।प्।). भा. IX. २२. 6; M. ५०. २८; वा. ९९. २२३; Vi. IV. १९. ८२.
(I)--a son of Uparicara and a king of the Cedis. भा. IX. २२. 6.
(II)--a son of Vasu. Vi. IV. १९. ८१.

--a son of कुश and father of गाधि or कौशीक, who was Indra himself who offered to be his son when कुशाम्ब performed austerities to have a child equal to Indra. (कुशाश्व-वा। प्।). भा. IX. १५. 4; Br. III. ६६. ३२; Vi. IV. 7. 8, 9-११; वा. ९१. ६२.
--a तीर्थम् sacred to पितृस्. M. २२. ६९. [page१-415+ २५]
--a son of ऋषभ. भा. V. 4. १०.
--one of the four sons of कुश. वा. ९१. ६२.
--a son of Bali. वा. ६७. ८३.
(I)--the king who engaged himself in austeri- ties for a son for one thousand years when Indra himself was born his son गाधि by name. See कुसस्तम्ब। Br. III. ६६. ३३. 5.
(II)--a great sage (विप्रऋषि)। वा. 1. १५७.
(III)--a son of the Nakuli अवतार् of the lord. वा. २३. २२३.
(IV)--the thirteenth kalpa so-called. वा. २१. ३२.
--a son of the अट्टहास अवआर् of the lord. वा. २३. १९३.
--the १३ sages being descendants of कुशिक, father of विश्वामित्र mentioned. Br. II. ३३. ११८-19.

--descendants of कुशिक;
1: भा. IX. १६. ३६-37.
kingdom of: sages of.
2: M. १२१. ५४; १९८. 8.
[page१-416+ २१]
--a son of Vasudeva and रोहिणी. Br. III. ७१. १६५; वा. ९६. १६३.
--one of the four chief disciples of पौष्यञ्जि. वा. ६१. ३६.
--(कुशीदि-ब्र्। प्।) a pupil of पौष्यञ्जि; learnt a hundred साम samhita1s. भा. XII. 6. ७९; Br. II. ३५. ४०.
--see कुशीद। Br. II. ३५. ४०.
--an asura who was attacked by लघुश्यामा. Br. IV. २८. ४०.
(I)--(Mt.) a hill of कुशद्वीप. Br. II. १९. ५५; वा. ४९. ५०; Vi. II. 4. ४१.
(II)--same as कङ्क. M. १२२. ५८.
--a तीर्थम् sacred to पितृस्. M. २२. ७६.
--a group of sages. Br. III. 1. ५५. [page१-417+ २३]
--a goddess enshrined at कुशद्वीप. M. १३. ५०.
--a group of पिशाचस् with no ears, hair or cloth; all skin; fond of flesh. Br. III. 7. ३७९ and ३८७.
--a group of पिशाचस्. Br. III. 7. ३७९ and ३८२.
--a daughter of सम्भूति and Marici. वा. २०. 9.
--an यक्ष, and a son of देवयानि. Br. III. 7. १२८.
--a वानर chief. Br. III. 7. २३१.
(II)--the city founded by उदायी on the south bank of the Ganges. Br. III. ७४. १३२.
--the city on the south bank of the Ganges founded by उदायि in his fourth year. वा. ९९. ३१९.
--the विमान or flying machine. Br. IV. १५. २६. [page१-418+ २४]
--the presiding deity of the Himalayas who kept watch and ward over the harem of उमा until her return from तपस्। M. १५६. 1-7.
--a श्रुतऋषि: a pupil of पौष्यञ्जि. Br. II. ३३. 8; ३५. ४०.
--a continent round Somaka hill. M. १२२-24.
--a son of Havya, after whom Kusumot- tara वर्ष was named. Br. II. १४. १७-20.
--a region of शाकद्वीप, adjoining the Asta hill. B. II. १४. २०; १९. ९२; वा. ४९. ८७.
--a son of Bhavya of शाकद्वीप. Vi. II. 4. ६०.
--one of eight सौभाग्यम्स्. M. ६०-9, २७.
--a son of मणिवस. वा. ६९. १५९.
--a सूक्त of the Yajur Vedins to be recited in tank rituals. M. ५८. ३५; २३९. १०.
--the collective name for १००० sons of कक्षीवत्. Br. III. ७४. ९९.

--a kind of evil spirits. To this group Kapi's sons belonged; said to harass children;
1: भा. VI. 8. २४; X. 6. २७; Br. III. 7. ३८४ and ४१. २९.
disturbed Dhruva's समाधि.
2: Vi. I. १२. १३.
[page१-423+ ३१]
--the son of कपिश; gave birth to two पिशचास् of brown colour; they have no head, no hair; they are eaters of flesh and तिल। वा. ६९. २५७, २६८.
